title: {{mark}}'s booking needs a second pair of eyes
obstacle: Over $1,000, an unattended agent call needs a human. {{mark}} cannot approve his own request.
control: The Cedar forbid s01-hold-large-fare names {{priya}} as approver. The call is held, and runs once after she approves.
say: The agent did not get smarter permissions. A human stayed in the loop for exactly the risky one.

steps.title: Dot books the fare
steps.tell: Sign in as {{mark}}. In the Tool console pick book_fare, amount 2400, tick the box that Dot makes the call, and add a short justification. Call.
steps.say: {{mark}} asked Dot to book it. The call is unattended, so the limit applies.
steps.why: The limit is on the agent acting alone. {{mark}} at the keyboard is not held by it.

steps.title: The call is held
steps.tell: The result card says hold, decided by s01-hold-large-fare, naming {{priya}} as approver. Nothing has run.
steps.say: It did not fail and it did not run. It is waiting for {{vocab.approverRole}}.
steps.why: A hold is only offered when an approval could end in allow.

steps.title: {{priya}} sees the request
steps.tell: Sign in as {{priya}} and open Approvals. The request shows the tool, the amount, who asked, which policy held it and the justification text.
steps.say: She sees exactly what she is approving and why it was held.
steps.why: The justification is shown to her but never read by the policy, so typing a clever reason cannot change the decision.

steps.title: {{priya}} answers
steps.tell: Approve. The call is checked again against the current policies with one approval, runs once, and the booking confirmation appears on the request.
steps.say: One click from the right person and the booking completes.
steps.why: An approval is re-checked against the current policies, not trusted: a policy changed in the meantime still applies. A denial simply ends the request without a re-check.

blocked.tell: Deny. The request shows denied by {{priya}} and the tool never ran. {{mark}} sees the reason on the request.

steps.title: Follow it in the trace
steps.tell: Open Trace (it lists newest first, so read it from the bottom). One request reads auth, cedar, pep (hold), then cedar again, tool and approval after the answer.
steps.say: One request, every hop, who decided at each.
steps.why: {{priya}}'s name is on the approval row, and the pep row before it shows s01-hold-large-fare, the rule that required her.

blocked.tell: Open Trace (newest first, so read it from the bottom). The same request reads auth, cedar, pep (hold), then approval (deny) after {{priya}} answers. There is no second cedar row and no tool row.
blocked.say: One request, every hop, and it stops at her no: the tool never ran.

proof.happy: The approved request: approver {{priya}}, executed, with the booking result, and the Trace rows for the hold and the approval.
proof.blocked: The denied request: denied by {{priya}}, executed false, and no tool hop in the Trace.
